baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَابَّةٍ مِن مَاءٍ with the three مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي clauses.
baseline_models.mechanism: One aqueous source is realized as an encompassing field of creatures whose movement is distributed across belly, two-leg, and four-support geometries. The repeated partitive construction preserves common origin while refusing uniform embodiment or rank.

activation_trace.role: Origination from something supplies the transition from shared water to living forms and the resumed creative act after their enumeration.
Encompassing totality links every creature at the opening with every thing under capacity at the close.
Literal water supplies the common material origin.
Repeated locomotion distributes one creaturely field into distinct modes of bodily transition.
The underside of the body becomes one direct ground-contact architecture.
The bodily leg supplies the paired support architecture.
The number four supplies the final explicitly counted support architecture.

changed_reading.before: A compact zoological list following a statement that animals come from water.
changed_reading.after: A unity-without-uniformity model: one material origin is deliberately unfolded into plural, non-ranked architectures of earthly movement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled خ ل ق frame and the close إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The measuring branch of creation and the amount-and-capacity branches of q-d-r make the counted body plans realized measures rather than arbitrary specimens. Capacity appears as the ability to fit form, support count, and locomotor function together.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring and proportioning make creation a specification of workable forms.
Completed and balanced form supplies the visible morphology that each gait requires.
A thing made upon four forces turns the final count into a structural support pattern.
Measure, limit, and due amount connect the conclusion to the counted configurations.
Effective capability closes the mechanism as power to realize each proportioned design.

changed_reading.before: The final قدير is a general assertion of omnipotence appended to animal diversity.
changed_reading.after: The final قدير interprets the diversity: power is displayed as measured fitness between created morphology and its mode of movement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: دَابَّةٍ and the threefold يَمْشِي, held inside the repeated act of خَلْق.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet's split d-b-b inventory lets the creature noun resonate not only with creeping but with sustained striving, continuing habit, and a way or disposition. Repeated walking then presents life as an enacted course whose outward gait and created inward nature remain coupled.

activation_trace.role: The form-distant split target contributes persistent striving and continuous passage as a resonance of creaturely life.
Slow or light movement on earth keeps the model anchored in literal creaturely locomotion.
Way, disposition, and moving like another extend gait into an enacted manner without replacing the noun's animal sense.
Three repetitions make ongoing movement the observable expression of the course.
Created inward nature supplies the dispositional side of the outward gait.

changed_reading.before: دابة is merely the taxonomic subject whose members happen to move differently.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, creaturehood is continuous enacted passage: created disposition becomes visible through a sustained mode of moving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated warning about following footsteps turns walking from an isolated bodily event into a cumulative track: one movement leaves an effect that another movement can follow. The focus ayah's three gaits remain physical, but now also expose how a course is built through sequenced motion.

activation_trace.role: Literal repeated locomotion supplies the focus anchor for a course assembled through movement.
Tracing effect after effect supplies the relation by which one movement becomes a followed course.
Footprints followed by a traveler supply the visible sequence that accumulates into a path.

structural_cues: 24:21 repeats both following and footsteps, while 24:45 repeats walking across three bodily configurations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal gait and a doubled sequence of followed footsteps; I infer that repeated movement can disclose a formed course. The live alternative is that 24:21 is exclusively moral-path language and leaves 24:45 purely anatomical.

changed_reading.before: Each walking clause reports a self-contained locomotor mechanism.
changed_reading.after: Each gait can also be seen as course-forming movement: bodily passage produces tracks capable of being followed, while direction supplies the later ethical valence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same leg-root used as a support in the focus later belongs to limbs that testify about performed work. Locomotor anatomy therefore becomes deed-bearing anatomy: the organ that carries a course also preserves its accountability.

activation_trace.role: The literal bodily leg anchors the two-support gait.
Locomotion supplies what the leg enacts through bodily passage.
Knowledge-bearing declaration turns bodily traces into testimony.
The exact organ-root returns as a witness, joining support and accountability.
Intended action supplies what the witnessing limbs disclose.

structural_cues: 24:24 coordinates tongues, hands, and legs as witnesses to what was done; 24:45 singles out legs as locomotor supports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact leg-root recurrence and explicitly makes later limbs testify to action; I infer that locomotion is deed-bearing embodiment. The alternative is a looser juxtaposition in which the anatomical and forensic uses remain independent.

changed_reading.before: Legs are neutral structural equipment in a body-plan inventory.
changed_reading.after: Legs are both supports of passage and future witnesses to enacted passage, so morphology carries an accountability-bearing history.

context_deltas.mechanism: The thirsty observer first encounters a waterlike mirage and finds no thing; the focus then presents actual water from which every creature is created and closes over every thing. Shared ماء and شيء vocabulary makes the second water an answer in material efficacy to the first water's failed appearance.

activation_trace.role: A gleam resembling water supplies the false aqueous appearance.
Literal water is what the thirsty observer takes the mirage to be.
Finding tests the projected object and replaces its absence with encounter of God.
The general knowable thing is explicitly negated at the apparent water.
Actual water supplies an efficacious source from which living bodies arise.
Creative origination converts the real source into creatures rather than a failed appearance.
Will and capacity return the thing-vocabulary from negated object to comprehensive reality.

structural_cues: 24:39 says apparent ماء yields no شيء; 24:45 says every creature is from ماء and closes with creative will and capacity over every شيء.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a close lexical reversal from apparent water/no thing to water/created creatures/every thing; I infer a contrast between projected appearance and divinely effective material reality. The alternative is that the two water references merely serve separate demonstrations.

changed_reading.before: From water is a standalone statement about biological material origin.
changed_reading.after: After the mirage, from water marks efficacious reality: divine creation makes real beings from what perception alone could only misrecognize as water.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby birds move through flight and ordered alignment before the focus enumerates belly, two-leg, and four-support walking. This widens the inventory: the three clauses classify ground-contact geometries rather than exhaust every creaturely mode.

activation_trace.role: Walking limits the explicit focus list to locomotion described through bodily ground support.
Literal legs make support geometry, rather than species identity, the middle category.
Light flight supplies a neighboring creaturely movement not reducible to the listed contact geometries.
Alignment on a level line supplies ordered form within the flying mode.
The encompassing each/all construction places the avian order inside the wider creaturely field.

structural_cues: 24:41 presents birds in ordered flight and says each knows its pattern; 24:45 later enumerates only forms introduced by يَمْشِي عَلَى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies avian flight near a list grammatically restricted to walking on supports; I infer that the latter is a ground-motion cross-section, not a closed ontology. Alternatively, birds may be included through their two-legged walking and the list may still claim comprehensiveness at another level.

changed_reading.before: Belly, two, and four are an exhaustive taxonomy of living creatures.
changed_reading.after: They are representative architectures of ground-contact movement inside a broader ordered repertoire that also includes flight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cloud material is gathered layer upon layer, releases rain, and is routed by will; night and day are then turned, and the focus turns to water differentiated into moving bodies. The sequence makes biological diversity one phase of a larger pattern in which a common material is gathered, routed, and refashioned into distinct effects.

activation_trace.role: Material gathered atop material supplies the compositional stage of the water cycle.
Descending rain supplies the immediate aqueous precursor to the focus's water.
Repeated willing routes the same meteorological material toward some and away from others.
Turning a thing from one face to another supplies a transition pattern immediately before bodily differentiation.
Making one condition an instructive analogue for another authorizes, without proving, the cross-domain comparison.
Water becomes the shared biological material carried into the next stage.
Measured creation assigns the common material distinct workable forms.
Creative willing echoes the prior routing formula while shifting from recipients of weather to forms of life.

structural_cues: 24:43-45 moves without interruption from gathered cloud and descending rain, through alternation as an عبرة, to every creature from water.
24:43 repeats مَن يَشَاءُ for distribution; 24:45 answers with مَا يَشَاءُ for creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent gathering, rain, turning, water-origin, and mirrored willing formulas; I infer a material analogy from atmospheric routing to biological differentiation. The live alternative is that these are parallel signs of power with no implied process link.

changed_reading.before: Water is a static ingredient named at the start of the creature account.
changed_reading.after: Water is a routed and transformable medium within a larger cycle, then measured into diverse living architectures by the same will.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gives several bodily ways of walking under what God creates; the next ayah gives one straight path under whom God guides. The juxtaposition separates legitimate morphological plurality from normative direction: gait differs by creation, while guidance concerns orientation rather than body type.

activation_trace.role: Three literal walking modes supply the plurality of embodied passage.
Creative willing governs which forms are brought into being.
Gentle direction toward road and truth supplies orientation rather than anatomy.
The repeated willing formula now selects the guided traveler rather than a created morphology.
The straight road supplies the single directional norm across plural bodies.
Straightness, balance, and evenness qualify the path, not the creature's body plan.

structural_cues: Adjacent ayat mirror يَخْلُقُ اللَّهُ مَا يَشَاءُ and اللَّهُ يَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ.
Plural walking configurations in 24:45 are followed by singular صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ in 24:46.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent, mirrored willing clauses and a shift from bodily gaits to a straight road; I infer a deliberate distinction between created embodiment and guided orientation. The alternative is formal parallelism without a contrastive claim.

changed_reading.before: Different gaits could invite an implicit ladder from low belly-crawling to upright movement.
changed_reading.after: The next ayah blocks bodily ranking: created gaits may be many, while straightness belongs to guidance and can orient any embodied traveler.

context_deltas.mechanism: After displaying every kind of earthbound mobility, the surah denies that agents can escape on earth. Created movement is real capacity, but it never becomes an outside to the Creator's encompassing capacity.

activation_trace.role: Creaturely locomotion supplies genuine but bounded capacities for movement.
Effective divine capacity supplies the encompassing asymmetry at the focus close.
Failure to outstrip or escape sets the outer limit on creaturely movement.
The lower realm opposite heaven supplies the same practical domain in which the listed gaits operate.

structural_cues: The surah that catalogs modes of earthly walking later says that agents cannot produce escape in the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies locomotor plurality, encompassing capacity, and a later denial of earthly escape; I infer a nested-capacity relation. The alternative is that 24:57 concerns accountability alone and does not look back to creaturely gait.

changed_reading.before: قدير celebrates the ability to generate highly varied movers.
changed_reading.after: قدير also bounds those movers: every created mobility remains operative inside, never beyond, divine capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The created plurality of bodily movement is later met by life-stage rules and a repeated removal of constraint for the blind, lame, and sick. Cosmological variation thus acquires a social consequence: no single gait may become the unspoken measure of full participation.

activation_trace.role: Completed bodily form supplies the created diversity to which social rules must respond.
Varied locomotion anchors the delta in differing embodied access rather than an abstract inclusion theme.
The life-stage category of women past menstruation and marriage is named through sitting, adding a legally recognized bodily status without reducing it to impairment.
Threefold removal of constriction prevents bodily condition from becoming a social barrier.
Lameness located in leg and bodily formation directly tests any norm built around ordinary walking.
Restricted movement from illness broadens the accommodated field beyond limb configuration.

structural_cues: 24:60 introduces a legally recognized life-stage body category; 24:61 then repeats لَيْسَ ... حَرَجٌ for blindness, lameness, and sickness before opening shared eating relations.
The focus's repeated walking forms and 24:61's lame body make locomotor difference a whole-surah concern rather than an isolated natural sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divinely created locomotor variation and later explicit removal of constraint around embodied limitations; I infer that creation's plurality should shape norm-sensitive participation. The alternative keeps the natural sign and household rule as independent domains.

changed_reading.before: Bodily diversity is something to observe as evidence of creative power.
changed_reading.after: Bodily diversity also disciplines community norms: different mobility and life-stage conditions call for accommodation, not lesser standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts walking from locomotion toward propagation across generations. It remains anchored in packet branches for reproductive water, the fetus-bearing interior, growth and offspring under m-sh-y, and life stages under d-b-b. Render it only as a branch-enabled reproductive resonance, never as a replacement for literal water, belly, or walking.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِنْ مَاءٍ, عَلَى بَطْنِهِ, repeated يَمْشِي, and the creature noun دَابَّة.

activation_trace.role: Male reproductive fluid placed in the womb supplies a possible generational specification of the stated water-origin.
The bodily interior that can contain a fetus supplies the hidden gestational site while the verse literally uses the belly as support.
Growth, increase, livestock, and offspring let movement resonate with a lineage's increase as well as an individual's gait.
Creaturely life stages supply a temporal span across which the propagative movement unfolds.
Origination keeps the generational resonance attached to the verse's explicit making of living beings.

changed_reading.before: The ayah tracks only how already formed individual animals locomote.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also compresses generational movement: reproductive water enters a hidden interior, becomes created life, and continues through growth, offspring, and gait.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets creaturely creeping illuminate a later human social exit. It remains anchored by the focus inventory's hidden-flow branch and the later packet's explicit slipping-out and concealment branches. Render it as a contrast in how neutral mobility can be purposed, not as animalization of the people in 24:63.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: دَابَّة and the repeated يَمْشِي as morally unmarked capacities for movement.

activation_trace.role: Hidden spreading beneath perceptual notice supplies a latent covert-motion possibility within the creature root.
Literal locomotion keeps the comparison tied to use of movement rather than identity.
Slipping out supplies the later deliberate exit motion.
Hiding behind another supplies the concealment strategy attached to that motion.

changed_reading.before: Creeping and walking differ only as natural locomotor mechanics.
changed_reading.after: The later covert exit makes movement ethically contrastive: created mobility is neutral, while concealment, direction, and purpose make a particular course accountable.

strongest_changes: The mirage sequence changes water from a generic origin claim into a contrast between failed appearance and materially effective creation.
The rain, alternation, and mirrored willing formulas place animal formation inside a larger pattern of routing and differentiating a common medium.
The next ayah separates many created gaits from one straight guided path, blocking moral ranking of body plans.
The later removal of constraint for lame and sick bodies turns observed locomotor plurality into a norm of accommodation.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly re-coded the focus's matter and motion: footsteps made gait course-forming, legs became witnesses, false water yielded no thing, birds widened the motion repertoire, rain supplied a transformable medium, guidance supplied direction, and mobility limits received social accommodation.
remaining_uncertainties: The mirage and rain links are strongly sequenced and lexically echoed, but the causal analogy from meteorology to biological formation remains reader-supplied.
The d-b-b split-target, generational, and covert-exit activations are deliberately form-distant and should remain exploratory resonances.
Bird flight may show a wider movement repertoire, or birds may still fit the focus through their two-legged walking; the packet does not force one scope.
